method: targeted Kyrgyz-English semantic review against printed page and adjacent context; inventory-142 manuscript alignment remains provisional
checked_by: Codex with parallel agent proposal reviewed by root
uncertainty: Rows 16, 20, 22–23, 26–27, 39–41, 56, 59–60, 63–67, 70, 76–80 retain syntactic, geographical, or idiomatic uncertainty; compare scan and specialist reading before treating as final.
The speaker is Sarybay and his address to Kuyaly continues from printed page 983 line 80.
Line 46 printed extraction reads каран; likely караң, but this proposal does not alter source transcription.

corrections.en: To that strong-armed infidel,
corrections.reason: каруусу = arm/strength; капыр = infidel. Epithet continued from p983:80.

corrections.old: A fire broke out in my heart,
corrections.en: Fire rose from my very core,
corrections.reason: өзөгүмөн is from my core/heart; retain fire image.

corrections.en: An enemy arose from within me,
corrections.reason: өз ичимен = from inside me; жоо = enemy.

corrections.en: The child truly struck down
corrections.reason: чындан каза = truly dead/slain; modifies баланы.

corrections.en: I see I am about to behold,
corrections.reason: көргөнү турган экемин = it seems I am standing ready to see; completes p984:04.

corrections.en: True death has come for my poor soul,
corrections.reason: ажал = death/fate; кайран жан = poor/dear soul. Syntax remains poetic.

corrections.en: It seems I have come to die.
corrections.reason: өлгөнү келген экемин = it seems I have come to die.

corrections.en: O trader in this fleeting world,
corrections.reason: бекер дүйнө = vain/empty world, соодагер = merchant; vocative sense probable.

corrections.en: Enamored of this world,
corrections.reason: кызыгып = attracted/enamored; бу дүнүйөгө = with this world.

corrections.en: What did I think I would gain?
corrections.reason: нетейин деген экемин = what did I mean to do; Netain is not a name.

corrections.en: Kuyaly, the one I clashed with,
corrections.reason: кагышканым = the one with whom I clashed, not a crush.

corrections.old: It was a soul from my land,
corrections.en: Was one who came from my own land,
corrections.reason: жеримден чыккан = arose from my land.

corrections.en: We jousted seven times,
corrections.reason: сайышып = jousted with lances; not injections.

corrections.old: He said he would do it for you.
corrections.en: And she said, 'I will do this to you.'
corrections.reason: сага муну кылам деди = she said I will do this to you; gender from Kuyaly.

corrections.old: A girl with a better name is a wrestler,
corrections.en: That renowned champion girl
corrections.reason: аты артык = of surpassing renown; кыз балбан = female champion.

corrections.en: Has come into her inheritance,
corrections.reason: мураасына жетиптир; inheritance may be figurative; retain literal reading.

corrections.en: Whoever she set her sights on died,
corrections.reason: тиктегени өлүптүр = the one she fixed her gaze on died.

corrections.old: He granted what he wished for.
corrections.en: What she wished for was granted,
corrections.reason: тилегенин бериптир = her wish was given; subject implicit.

corrections.old: He killed the one who caught him.
corrections.en: Whoever grappled with her died,
corrections.reason: кармашканы = person who grappled with her; parallel to p984:17.

corrections.en: And her challenger has come.
corrections.reason: кагышканы келиптир = one who clashed with her has arrived; referent uncertain.

corrections.en: Kayipchal's champion daughter,
corrections.reason: балбан кыз = champion/wrestler girl; Kayipchal father.

corrections.old: You are a girl from the dark sky,
corrections.en: You dark-hearted, swaggering girl,
corrections.reason: кара көөдөн = dark-hearted/broad-chested uncertain; дардаң = swaggering/boastful.

corrections.old: The girl left from the boat.
corrections.en: A girl cast off by the people,
corrections.reason: калайыктан калган = left by/behind the people; cast off is contextual and uncertain.

corrections.old: The edge of your village is white,
corrections.en: At your village's edge stands a white cliff,
corrections.reason: ак кыя = white cliff, not merely white.

corrections.old: Shurkuya, who has lost his conscience.
corrections.en: You shameless, reckless woman!
corrections.reason: абийири кеткен = honor lost; шуркуя = reckless/unruly woman, derogatory in context.

corrections.en: No waist for a hand to pass around,
corrections.reason: сыдыр барган бели жок: retain literal body image; exact idiom uncertain.

corrections.old: There is no husband who does not pray.
corrections.en: No man who has not bowed to you,
corrections.reason: сыйынбаган эри жок = no man who has not bowed/honored; эри may be husband/man.

corrections.en: A noble-born champion girl,
corrections.reason: бекзааданын = noble-born/nobleman's; берен кыз = heroic/champion girl.

corrections.en: Becoming a giant beyond measure,
corrections.reason: эсеби жок = beyond measure; дөө = giant.

corrections.old: Is it easy to find a husband?
corrections.en: Is it right for her to go seeking a man?
corrections.reason: эр издеген оңобу = is it proper to seek a husband/man; rhetorical question.

corrections.old: A lonely girl like a princess
corrections.en: A lone girl like a princess,
corrections.reason: канзаададай = like a prince/princess; жалгыз кыз = only/lone daughter.

corrections.en: Should she go out to grapple?
corrections.reason: кармашка чыккан болорбу = could/should she enter combat; no arrest.

corrections.old: People roam around and violate the country,
corrections.en: Roaming among the people and unsettling the land,
corrections.reason: эл кыдырып = roam among people; журт бузган = disrupt a people/land.

corrections.en: Could there be a troublemaker like you?
corrections.reason: бейпай = unsettled/troublesome; senдей = like you.

corrections.old: The only girl of Esil Zat,
corrections.en: The only daughter of a noble soul,
corrections.reason: эсил заттын = worthy/dear person's; not proper name Esil Zat.

corrections.old: Is it worth looking for a husband?
corrections.en: Is it fitting for her to seek a man?
corrections.reason: эр издеген оңорбу repeats p984:30.

corrections.en: Could there be a troublemaker like you,
corrections.reason: бейпай сенче = troublemaker such as you; not 'do you think so'.

corrections.en: Unless you meet me face to face?
corrections.reason: беттешпесең болобу = can you avoid facing me; rhetorical challenge.

corrections.old: I draw a sword and sheathe it,
corrections.en: I draw my sword and sheath it,
corrections.reason: кылыч сууруп кындаймын literally draw a sword and sheath it; action sequence unclear.

corrections.en: Now roused, I speak in earnest.
corrections.reason: кызып = inflamed/roused; чындаймын = make true/speak earnestly; exact force uncertain.

corrections.en: You cast poison into my ashes,
corrections.reason: күлүмө = into my ashes, possibly hearth; not smile. Metaphor uncertain.

corrections.en: Making your secret known to strangers,
corrections.reason: жатка = to outsiders/strangers; билгизип = making known.

corrections.old: That's how you got to the bottom.
corrections.en: Thus you brought me to ruin.
corrections.reason: түбүмө жеттиң = brought me to my end/ruin; idiom.

corrections.old: Hold on, you're out of the way
corrections.en: You grappled with me, then turned away,
corrections.reason: кармаш кылдың = you grappled; четтедиң = stepped aside/turned away.

corrections.en: You scorched my poor soul.
corrections.reason: кайран жанды = poor soul; өрттөдүң = burned/scorched.

corrections.old: You made your work a nightmare
corrections.en: You made all your deeds dark as night,
corrections.reason: ишиңди караң түн кылдың = made deeds a black night; караң likely OCR missing ң.

corrections.en: You darkened my heart.
corrections.reason: көңүлүмдү кир кылдың = made my heart/spirit soiled.

corrections.old: You didn't do one thing, you did a thousand.
corrections.en: You did it not once but a thousand times,
corrections.reason: бир кылбадың миң кылдың = not once but a thousand times.

corrections.old: Why did you fight so much?
corrections.en: Why did you stir up so much strife?
corrections.reason: чыр кылдың = made strife/quarrel.

corrections.en: You bound my fortune,
corrections.reason: багымды = my luck/fortune; not my garden.

corrections.old: I was a hero, I was a lion,
corrections.en: I was a warrior, I was a lion,
corrections.reason: баатыр = warrior; шер = lion/hero.

corrections.old: You broke my heart a lot.
corrections.en: Yet you broke my spirit again and again.
corrections.reason: шагымды сындырдың = broke my resolve/spirit.

corrections.old: You spent a lot of money,
corrections.en: You drained so much of my strength,
corrections.reason: алымды = my strength/power, not money.

corrections.old: You hurt my soul a lot,
corrections.en: You so often drove my soul to fury,
corrections.reason: жанымды кашайттың = enraged/tormented my soul; see dictionary кашай- idiom.

corrections.en: Starting trouble every day,
corrections.reason: балаа = calamity/trouble, not childhood.

corrections.en: Together you brought me to ruin.
corrections.reason: тубүмө жеттиң = brought me to my end; чогуу may mean together/all at once, referent uncertain.

corrections.en: My anger rises and I stiffen,
corrections.reason: каарым келип = my anger comes; какайып = stiffening.

corrections.old: I won't miss one of you,
corrections.en: I will not leave any one of you unchallenged,
corrections.reason: катылбай койбойм бириңе = I will not fail to pick a fight with one of you.

corrections.old: On the edge of the dog walk,
corrections.en: On the edge of It-Zhürbös, where no dog goes,
corrections.reason: Ит жүрбөстүн may be a place name or descriptive epithet; preserve both.

corrections.en: I barely escaped with my life.
corrections.reason: өлбөй араң калыштым = I barely survived, not barely died.

corrections.en: I owe no vengeance for your father,
corrections.reason: мадер = father; idiom 'мадериң өчү менде жок' means why pursue me when I have not killed your father.

corrections.en: Yet you have fought so many such battles,
corrections.reason: мындай далай салыштың = you fought many such bouts; precise form uncertain.

corrections.en: Swaggering though your strength fails,
corrections.reason: чалкып = swaggering/rolling; чамаң келалбай = lacking the ability; nuance uncertain.

corrections.old: Karabet does not take revenge on you,
corrections.en: You black-faced wretch, until I take revenge on you,
corrections.reason: карабет = shameful/black-faced epithet; сенден кек албай = without taking revenge on you.

corrections.en: Until I throw you from your horse,
corrections.reason: оодарып аттан түшүрүп = overturn/dismount you; links p984:67.

corrections.en: If I do not take you then,
corrections.reason: ошондо сени мен албай = if I do not take you then; negative vow continues, contextual syntax uncertain.

corrections.en: You paid no heed to my words,
corrections.reason: санга албай сөзүмдү = not accounting/valuing my word.

corrections.en: You made me a neglected suitor,
corrections.reason: салбар = neglected person/spouse; gendered dictionary sense adapted to Sarybay's complaint.

corrections.en: You must have loved making me forlorn,
corrections.reason: салбарлыкка сүйүпсүң = you desired/liked the state of being neglected; syntax unclear.

corrections.old: Put grass on my yellow trail,
corrections.en: You tracked my every step,
corrections.reason: сары изиме чөп салып = relentless pursuit idiom, not literal grass on a yellow trail.

corrections.en: And chased me until you grew pale,
corrections.reason: саргара = to yellow/pale with pursuit; кууп жүрүпсүң = kept chasing.

corrections.en: On the plain of Zhelpinish,
corrections.reason: Желпиниш = place name; оюнда = on its lowland/plain, not someone's mind.

corrections.en: I slew whoever came upon me,
corrections.reason: кабылганды кыргамын = I slaughtered those encountered; not bark.

corrections.en: Without saying what I had to say,
corrections.reason: айтпай кетип сөзүмдү = departed without saying my words; links p984:76.

corrections.en: I went away without taking myself [unclear],
corrections.reason: албай кетип өзүмдү literally 'went without taking myself'; unclear or idiomatic, so mark uncertainty rather than invent object.

corrections.en: Here I was made to feel neglected,
corrections.reason: мында салбар кылгамын = here I made/was made neglected; agency uncertain; no botanical branching.

corrections.en: You are false to everyone born,
corrections.reason: жаралганга = to those created/born; жалгансың = you are false.

corrections.en: You are a soul burned by grief,
corrections.reason: жаның күйгөн = soul burned/grieved, not 'passionate' in positive sense.

corrections.en: Such grief has come over you.
corrections.reason: күйүтүң өттү ушундай = your grief has passed/come to this; exact temporal sense uncertain.
